items.title: Why expertise repels beginners
items.content_text: She is smart. Experienced. She has been doing this for years. A young colleague approaches her with a question. A simple one. Almost naive. She answers with precision. Depth. Accuracy. She gives him the full picture, including the exceptions, the nuances, the history behind each decision. He nods. Says thank you. And walks away feeling more confused than before. She does not understand what happened. She was helpful. She was correct. Why did he not feel helped? This is the paradox of knowledge.

Out of 23,918 submissions, only 536 papers — about 2.2% — received Spotlight status, recognizing the highest-rated work reviewed by the program committee.
